participation.context: Conned the opening and shut the roll.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You rehearsed Egeon's opening for Thursday and left the king sheet shut.

participation.context: Read the two bills and left the post.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: the Rose's bill, read and left

story.body: The Theatre's bill and the Rose's stood on one post. You read both and walked north.

relations.note: the Rose's bill, read and left

title: Read the Theatre's bill and the Rose's bill

participation.context: Stood in the door, and did not go on.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Played Launce to an empty rope. He was not spoken with.
participation.name: Will Kemp

relations.note: Launce, a rope, and no dog on the end of it

story.body: You stayed in the tiring-house door. Kemp's Launce played to an empty rope. No dog came on.

relations.note: Launce, a rope, and no dog on the end of it

title: Stood in the door while Launce played to an empty rope
